title: Remote Investment Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
  • Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion.
  • Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents.
  • Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits.
  • Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds.
  • Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast;
    your documents still close cleanly.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Technical Sales Engineer

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.


This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.


Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.


What you’ll do


Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting


  • Act as a technical advisor and subject matter expert for customers and partners.
  • Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches.
  • Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers.
  • Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.

  • Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including SaaS, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings.
  • Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives.
  • Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows.
  • Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring.
  • Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps.
  • Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.


Pre-Sales Support

  • Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria.
  • Participate in RFP and RFI processes.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Discovery e Estratégia de Produto: Executar processos de discovery de forma independente, definindo métricas de sucesso da squad, acompanhando indicadores de produto (funil, churn, CSAT, NPS) e questionando objetivos com base em evidências.
  • Pesquisa e Validação (UX Research): Planejar, moderar e analisar testes de usabilidade, testes A/B, entrevistas e card sorting. Configurar e extrair aprendizados de ferramentas de dados (Maze, Hotjar, GA, etc.) para embasar a evolução do produto.
  • Eficiência e Inovação de Processos: Incorporar ferramentas modernas e fluxos assistidos por IA no dia a dia para otimizar etapas do ciclo de design (como ideação, prototipagem ágil e passagem de bastão para engenharia), elevando o patamar de entregabilidade do time.
  • Arquitetura da Informação e Conteúdo: Estruturar hierarquias claras através de mapas mentais, sitemaps e diagramas. Aplicar heurísticas e diretrizes do Guia de Escrita para equilibrar linguagem verbal e visual de ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir a Comunicação Estratégica: Comunicar de maneira objetiva a evolução do produto, consolidando e apresentando status, aprendizados e resultados para stakeholders e lideranças.


O que você precisa ter

  • Prototipagem Assistida por IA: Fluência no uso de IA generativa (Cursor, Claude, Figma Make) para acelerar a ideação visual e criação de protótipos de baixa a alta fidelidade, sendo capaz de fazer aplicação de bibliotecas de componentes escaláveis (Design Tokens e tematização).
  • Domínio em UX Research: Experiência comprovada em planejar e executar pesquisas com usuários de forma independente, desde o recrutamento até a apresentação de relatórios executivos.
  • Arquitetura da Informação Sólida: Capacidade de traduzir modelos mentais de usuários em fluxos lógicos e cenários de exceção detalhados em projetos de média a alta complexidade.
  • Pensamento Analítico de Produto: Conhecimento profundo na leitura e acompanhamento de métricas de jornada, conectando iniciativas de design a KPIs e KRs de negócio.
  • Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para defender de maneira técnica e embasada o racional das escolhas de design, articulando-se bem com stakeholders e times pares (Desenvolvimento, Negócios, Conteúdo).
  • Bagagem UX/UI no Figma com a maturidade de Product Thinking e Métricas.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido em Curitiba/PR, com visitas esporádicas no cliente a cada 15 dias.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions;
    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets;
    familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Supervisor(A) De Qualidade E Operações De Transmissões Ao Vivo
description:
City Explorer – Plataforma Global de Livestreaming

⠀Localização: Remoto — São Paulo, Brasil

⠀Salário-base inicial: USD 300 por mês

⠀Disponibilidade: Janela diária de nove horas. O turno exato e os dias de trabalho serão definidos posteriormente.

⠀Idiomas obrigatórios: Português (C2) e inglês (C2)

⠀Espanhol: Será considerado um diferencial

⠀

⠀

VOCÊ CONSEGUE IDENTIFICAR UM PROBLEMA DE QUALIDADE ANTES QUE O PÚBLICO PERCEBA?

⠀Você entende o que torna uma transmissão ao vivo profissional, envolvente e interessante?

⠀Sabe liderar pessoas, dar feedback claro e transformar problemas recorrentes em processos melhores?

⠀A City Explorer está procurando um(a) Supervisor(a) de Qualidade e Operações de Transmissões ao Vivo para assumir a responsabilidade pela qualidade da nossa operação em português.

⠀Esta é uma oportunidade para entrar em uma plataforma internacional em crescimento, trabalhar diretamente com a liderança e participar da construção dos processos que definirão o futuro da nossa operação.

⠀

⠀

SOBRE A CITY EXPLORER

⠀A City Explorer é uma plataforma global que conecta pessoas e culturas por meio de experiências autênticas transmitidas em tempo real.

⠀Todos os dias, nossos Explorers mostram cidades, ruas, culturas, paisagens, negócios e situações do cotidiano para espectadores de diferentes partes do mundo.

⠀Eles recebem equipamentos profissionais, treinamento estruturado e acompanhamento de uma equipe internacional de coaches.

⠀À medida que a plataforma cresce, a qualidade das transmissões precisa crescer junto. Por isso, buscamos alguém capaz de manter padrões elevados e ajudar coaches e Explorers a melhorar continuamente.

⠀

⠀

SUA MISSÃO

⠀Sua missão será simples e importante:

⠀Tornar cada transmissão melhor.

⠀Você coordenará coaches, acompanhará a qualidade das transmissões, identificará problemas recorrentes e garantirá que os Explorers recebam orientações claras, úteis e consistentes.

⠀Você será o principal ponto de conexão entre nossos Explorers de língua portuguesa, a equipe de coaches e a liderança da City Explorer.

⠀Esta é uma função prática para alguém que gosta de assumir responsabilidades, resolver problemas e gerar melhorias visíveis e mensuráveis.

⠀

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Coordenar e apoiar os coaches responsáveis pelos Explorers de língua portuguesa
  • Monitorar a qualidade técnica, a apresentação e a experiência do público
  • Garantir que os coaches forneçam feedback claro, construtivo e consistente
  • Identificar problemas recorrentes e acompanhar sua resolução
  • Estabelecer e manter padrões de qualidade
  • Apoiar o onboarding e o desenvolvimento de coaches e Explorers
  • Melhorar processos de monitoramento, comunicação e relatórios
  • Acompanhar o desempenho e identificar áreas que exigem atenção
  • Encaminhar problemas técnicos ou operacionais graves para a liderança
  • Trabalhar diretamente com a direção da City Explorer
  • Ajudar a construir sistemas de qualidade que possam crescer com a plataforma

⠀

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS ⠀

  • Português em nível C2 ou nativo
  • Inglês em nível C2 ou proficiência profissional equivalente
  • Experiência com liderança, supervisão ou coordenação de equipes
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Segurança para orientar pessoas e avaliar desempenho
  • Forte capacidade de organização e resolução de problemas
  • Alto nível de atenção aos detalhes
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes países e fusos horários
  • Capacidade de administrar várias prioridades
  • Interesse genuíno por livestreaming, mídia digital e experiência do público


EXPERIÊNCIA VALORIZADA

Será valorizada experiência em uma ou mais destas áreas:⠀

  • Transmissões ao vivo
  • Mídia digital ou broadcasting
  • Produção de conteúdo
  • Gestão de criadores ou talentos
  • Coaching ou treinamento
  • Controle de qualidade
  • Experiência do cliente
  • Supervisão de equipes remotas
  • Gestão de operações


COMO SERÁ O SUCESSO NESTA FUNÇÃO? ⠀

  • Nos primeiros três meses, esperamos que você ajude a alcançar:⠀
  • Feedback mais claro e consistente por parte dos coaches
  • Melhoria visível na qualidade das transmissões em português
  • Identificação mais rápida de problemas técnicos e de apresentação
  • Resolução mais eficiente de problemas recorrentes

POR QUE TRABALHAR NA CITY EXPLORER? ⠀

  • Coordene e apoie uma equipe internacional de coaches
  • Trabalhe diretamente com a liderança da empresa
  • Ajude a desenvolver novos sistemas e processos
  • Veja o impacto real das suas decisões
  • Trabalhe remotamente com profissionais de diferentes países
  • Tenha acesso a revisões salariais por desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento a partir do terceiro mês
  • Cresça junto com uma plataforma em expansão internacional


SALÁRIO E DISPONIBILIDADE

⠀O salário-base inicial é de USD 300 por mês .

⠀A função exige uma janela diária de disponibilidade de nove horas .

⠀O turno, os dias de trabalho e a cobertura de fusos horários serão discutidos e definidos durante o processo seletivo.

⠀A primeira avaliação de desempenho será realizada a partir do terceiro mês, com possibilidade de progressão salarial e aumento de responsabilidades.

⠀

⠀

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

⠀As candidaturas serão analisadas continuamente.

⠀

Envie uma breve apresentação incluindo:⠀

  • Sua experiência profissional relevante

Se você está pronto(a) para assumir responsabilidades, liderar pessoas e elevar a qualidade das transmissões de uma plataforma internacional em crescimento, queremos conhecer você.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)


Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Overseas Pre-Sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.


Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Consultor Financeiro
description:
CONSULTOR(A) FINANCEIRO(A) — LANCE CONSÓRCIOSobre o cargo

A Lance Consórcio busca profissionais com perfil comercial, ambição e vontade de crescer para fazer parte do nosso time como Consultor(a) Financeiro(a) .

O profissional atuará diretamente no atendimento e relacionamento com clientes, entendendo seus objetivos financeiros e patrimoniais e apresentando soluções de crédito e consórcio de forma estratégica e personalizada.

Atualmente, nosso principal foco comercial é a comercialização de cartas de crédito contempladas , oferecendo ao cliente uma alternativa de crédito de baixo custo financeiro para diferentes objetivos, como tracionar negócios, impulsionar empresas, realizar alavancagem patrimonial, alavancagem financeira e viabilizar aquisições estratégicas .

Além das cartas contempladas, o consultor também terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com cotas novas de consórcio , ampliando seu portfólio de soluções e suas possibilidades de negócio.

Você não começa do zero

Um dos grandes diferenciais da Lance Consórcio é que o consultor não precisa construir sua operação do zero .

A empresa disponibiliza:

  • Carteira de clientes e contatos para trabalho ;
  • Treinamentos completos sobre produtos e soluções;
  • Capacitação comercial e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Assessoria durante os atendimentos e negociações;
  • Suporte da equipe comercial;
  • Participação emreuniões e acompanhamentos;
  • Materiais de apoio para o desenvolvimento das vendas;
  • Estrutura para que o profissional possa desenvolver sua carteira e seus resultados.

Por isso, não buscamos necessariamente profissionais que já dominem o mercado de consórcios. Buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, perfil comercial, boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e, principalmente, vontade de crescer.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes e potenciais clientes;
  • Trabalhar a carteira de clientes disponibilizada pela empresa;
  • Realizar prospecção e desenvolver novas oportunidades;
  • Identificar o perfil, momento e objetivos financeiros de cada cliente;
  • Apresentar soluções de crédito e consórcio de forma personalizada;
  • Atuar principalmente na comercialização de cartas de crédito contempladas ;
  • Trabalhar também com cotas novas de consórcio ;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais;
  • Conduzir reuniões e apresentações;
  • Negociar e acompanhar oportunidades até a conclusão da venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes e buscar indicações;
  • Registrar atendimentos e oportunidades nos sistemas internos;
  • Acompanhar metas, indicadores e resultados individuais;
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões e atividades de desenvolvimento comercial.
Perfil que buscamos

Procuramos profissionais que tenham:

  • Perfil proativo e empreendedor ;
  • Comunicação clara e persuasiva;
  • Poder de negociação;
  • Foco em metas eresultados;
  • Ambição profissional;
  • Facilidade paracriar e desenvolver relacionamentos;
  • Boa postura profissional;
  • Organização e comprometimento;
  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Energia e disposição para atuar em um ambiente comercial dinâmico.
Não é necessário saber tudo sobre consórcio.

Se você possui boa comunicação, capacidade de relacionamento, vontade de aprender e ambição para crescer , nós fornecemos o treinamento, o conhecimento dos produtos, a estrutura e o suporte necessários para você desenvolver sua atuação.

Qualificações
  • Experiência com vendas, atendimento comercial ou relacionamento com clientes será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento ouinteresse em finanças, crédito, planejamento financeiro ou organização patrimonial;
  • Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade de negociação e argumentação;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de atendimento/CRM;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação presencial;
  • Ensino médio completo.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado de consórcios;
  • Experiência comprodutos financeiros ou crédito;
  • Experiência comvendas consultivas e de alto ticket;
  • Possuir uma boarede de contatos;
  • Possuir carteira ou histórico de relacionamento com clientes;
  • Experiência comercial em áreas como vendas, seguros, crédito, imóveis, veículos ou serviços financeiros.
O que oferecemos
  • Altas comissões ;
  • Ajuda de custo;
  • Premiações mensais;
  • Carteira de clientes para trabalho;
  • Treinamentos constantes;
  • Desenvolvimentoe crescimento profissional;
  • Suporte comercial e acompanhamento;
  • Materiais de apoio;
  • Ambiente comercial dinâmico e motivador;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Reconhecimento interno;
  • Estrutura e suporte para desenvolvimento da carreira.
Quem é a Lance Consórcio?

Somos uma empresa focada em soluções de crédito e estratégias de alavancagem financeira e patrimonial , utilizando o consórcio como ferramenta para ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem seus objetivos.

Aqui, o consultor não trabalha apenas com a venda de um produto. Nosso objetivo é entender o momento do cliente e apresentar estratégias de crédito que façam sentido para seus objetivos pessoais, profissionais e patrimoniais .

Se você é uma pessoa ambiciosa, comunicativa, proativa, gosta de desafios e quer construir uma carreira comercial com alto potencial de ganhos , queremos conhecer você.

Venha fazer parte da Lance Consórcio.

title: Supervisor Fiscal
description:
Supervisor(a) Fiscal Tributário


Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) Fiscal Tributário para atuar em uma empresa de grande porte, liderando as rotinas fiscais e tributárias e garantindo a conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Se você possui sólida experiência na área fiscal, perfil de liderança, visão analítica e busca um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Supervisionar as rotinas de apuração e recolhimento de tributos municipais, estaduais e federais.
  • Revisar e validar notas fiscais, garantindo a correta apuração dos impostos a recolher e a recuperar.
  • Acompanhar as constantes alterações da legislação tributária e da Reforma Tributária, disseminando as atualizações para a equipe.
  • Coordenar e revisar o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias, assegurando conformidade e cumprimento dos prazos legais.
  • Atuar no atendimento de fiscalizações municipais, estaduais e federais, bem como prestar suporte em auditorias.
  • Apoiar estudos tributários e a implementação de estratégias fiscais que contribuam para maior eficiência dos processos.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento da equipe, promovendo capacitação técnica e melhoria contínua.
  • Estruturar processos, controles internos e procedimentos da área fiscal.
  • Identificar e corrigir gaps sistêmicos e cadastrais, contribuindo para a integração dos sistemas fiscais e ERP.
  • Participar de projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária e implantação de novos controles e soluções fiscais.
  • Elaborar análises, relatórios gerenciais e propor melhorias para otimização dos processos.


Requisitos


  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada na área Fiscal e Tributária.
  • Vivência em liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal.
  • Experiência com apuração de impostos, obrigações acessórias e atendimento à fiscalização.
  • Conhecimento em ERP e ferramentas de gestão fiscal.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com foco em melhoria de processos.


Será considerado um diferencial


  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Contabilidade Tributária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência em implantação de processos, controles fiscais e integração de sistemas.
  • Vivência em empresas de médio ou grande porte.


Perfil desejado


Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil de liderança, excelente capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica, senso de urgência, organização e habilidade para atuar em um ambiente de constante atualização da legislação tributária, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos e o desenvolvimento da equipe.


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial – São Paulo/SP

Interessados(as): Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo informando sua pretensão salarial.

title: Supervisor(A) De Operações
description:

Essa pessoa terá um papel importante na conexão entre Atendimento, Criação, Mídia, Planejamento e demais áreas envolvidas nos projetos, acompanhando o fluxo das entregas e apoiando os times na priorização e resolução de possíveis gargalos.

Acompanhar a capacidade dos times e apoiar na organização e priorização das demandas;

Apoiar os gestores na definição de prioridades e planejamento das entregas;

Conduzir reuniõesde acompanhamento de projetos e status operacional;

Organizar e acompanhar processos internos, propondo melhorias que tragam maior eficiência para a operação;

Apoiar na implementação e utilização de ferramentas de gestão de projetos;

Fazer interface com fornecedores e parceiros quando necessário;

Garantir visibilidade sobre o andamento dos projetos para as lideranças e áreas envolvidas;

Acompanhar campanhas, analisar métricas e emissão de relatórios.


Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência anterior em operações, gestão de projetos, tráfego ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em agência de publicidade, comunicação ou marketing;

Experiência com acompanhamento de múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas;

Conhecimento da dinâmica e dos fluxos de uma agência de publicidade;

Boa capacidade deorganização, planejamento e priorização;

Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas e perfis profissionais;

Perfil proativo ecom capacidade de antecipar problemas e propor soluções;

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão de projetos e organização de demandas, como Skills ou similares;

Conhecimento de Excel/Google Sheets e ferramentas do pacote Office/Google Workspace.

Diferenciais

Experiência com gestão de capacidade e alocação de equipes;

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis;

Experiência com indicadores de produtividade e eficiência operacional;

Vivência com gestão de fornecedores e controle de custos de projetos;

Experiência em agências digitais ou integradas.

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho! 🚀


Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...


I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre


Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.


Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade. 🤟

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Inside Sales Manager
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 29 years.


We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world. Today our team has more than 5 500 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.


Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving.


Kaspersky is looking for an Inside Sales Manager to drive SMB sales growth in Brazil by developing relationships with customers and channel partners and identifying new business opportunities. This role is responsible for managing sales pipelines, supporting partners throughout the sales cycle, positioning Kaspersky solutions and value proposition, and helping to win deals against the competition.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Consistently meet or exceed sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory;
  • Drive SMB salesthrough channel partners, including new business, renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities;
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners and SMB customers;
  • Identify, assess and develop new business opportunities and prospective customers;
  • Manage and progress sales pipelines, ensuring accurate forecasting and execution against business goals;
  • Promote and clearly articulate Kaspersky’s value proposition and competitive advantages to partners and customers;
  • Recruit, train and enable partners to effectively position and sell Kaspersky solutions;
  • Balance farmingand hunting activities by developing existing accounts while acquiring new customers;
  • Conduct regularfollow-ups and coordinate with partners to support deal progression and increase win rates;
  • Work closely with Sales, Channel and Marketing teams on joint sales and marketing activities;
  • Support webinars, events, product demonstrations and other activities aimed at generating demand and business opportunities;
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, partner engagements and opportunities.


Required Experience, Skills and Competencies:


  • 5–8 years of experience in Sales, Account Management or Business Development within the technology industry;
  • Strong understanding of the full sales cycle and experience managing sales pipelines and business opportunities;
  • Experience selling technology solutions, services or complex projects based on customer needs and business value;
  • Experience in both new business development and existing account management;
  • Experience working with customers and channel partners;
  • Strong sales and business development skills with a focus on achieving revenue targets;

  • Strong teamworkand cross-functional collaboration skills;

  • Result-orientedmindset;

title: Atendimento Ao Cliente | Afirmativa Pcd
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay

Local de trabalho: Pinheiros - SP

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido


Nosso contexto

Na Gringo & Zapay, existimos para simplificar a vida de quem dirige. Somos um ecossistema tecnológico que atua com autonomia, responsabilidade e colaboração, usando dados e inteligência para transformar burocracia em soluções reais.

Aqui, cultura não é discurso, ela se manifesta nas decisões, nas entregas e na forma como nos relacionamos. Buscamos pessoas que assumem a direção do que fazem, simplificam problemas complexos e constroem juntas.


Como esperamos que você atue aqui

  • Assuma a Direção: seja responsável pelas entregas do início ao fim, cumpra combinados e corrija a rota com senso de urgência.

  • Simplifique a Rota: transforme complexidade em clareza, desburocratizando processos e comunicando de forma objetiva.
  • Atue Juntos: compartilhe contexto, construa pontes entre áreas, dê e receba feedbacks com respeito e maturidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atender e encantar os nossos clientes através dos canais de comunicação da Zapay, principalmente online (WhatsApp, E-mail, Redes Sociais) e Telefone (0800)

  • Registrar e acompanhar solicitações e reclamações buscando soluções ágeis e eficazes para garantir a satisfação dos clientes

  • Atuar de forma ativa nas demandas da área, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, execução e acompanhamento dos impactos das entregas.
  • Participar das tomadas de decisão, contribuindo com análises, dados e visão crítica.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas e pessoas, compartilhando informações, aprendizados e contexto.
  • Buscar constantemente formas mais simples, eficientes e sustentáveis de resolver problemas.

É imprescindível que você tenha:

description:

Coordenar as operações e os programas de Saúde Corporativa, por meio da gestão dos processos assistenciais e ocupacionais, indicadores, equipe e iniciativas de promoção à saúde, visando a manter a qualidade dos serviços, cumprir os requisitos legais e regulatórios e promover o cuidado integral e a qualidade de vida dos colaboradores.

  • Experiência em gestão assistencial, acompanhamento de casos de saúde e programas de promoção da saúde e qualidade de vida;

  • Conhecimento dalegislação trabalhista e previdenciária aplicada à Saúde Ocupacional;
  • Conhecimento emindicadores de saúde, absenteísmo, afastamentos, sinistralidade e utilização do plano de saúde;

CONFIRA ABAIXO AS PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES DESTA POSIÇÃO:

  • Coordenar as atividades de Saúde Corporativa, por meio da organização das demandas, acompanhamento da equipe e orientação técnica, visando a manter a qualidade dos processos e promover o desenvolvimento dos profissionais;
  • Planejar programas e ações de promoção da saúde, prevenção de doenças, saúde mental e qualidade de vida, com base no perfil epidemiológico e nas necessidades dos colaboradores, a fim de promover o bem-estar e reduzir riscos relacionados à saúde;
  • Supervisionar os atendimentos e acompanhamentos assistenciais e ocupacionais, por meio da aplicação de protocolos, análise de casos e monitoramento dos colaboradores, visando a preservar a saúde, mitigar riscos e manter a qualidade da assistência;
  • Controlar o acompanhamento de internações, procedimentos cirúrgicos, clínicos e obstétricos dos beneficiários, para monitoramento das autorizações e utilização do plano de saúde, com objetivo de otimizar os recursos e contribuir para a adequada gestão assistencial;

  • Apoiar gestorese áreas parceiras na condução de temas relacionados à saúde dos colaboradores, para orientação técnica e atuação integrada, para facilitar a tomada de decisão e promover soluções adequadas às necessidades do negócio;

title: Talent Attraction And Acquisition Professional
description:
Building connections. Creating possibilities.


Every terminal moves cargo. At Pecém , we move opportunities.


As one of Brazil's most important gateways for international trade and industrial growth, APM Terminals Pecém plays a critical role in connecting businesses, markets, and communities around the world.


At APM Terminals Pecém, employees become part of one of Brazil’s most dynamic and strategically positioned gateways for global trade. With sustained growth, expanding capabilities, and continued investment, Pecém offers a high-impact environment where scale, complexity, and opportunity come together. Behind this success is a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement.


Why you'll love it here

  • Contribute to an operation that helps drive economic growth and international connectivity.
  • Work in an environment where innovation and improvement are encouraged.
  • Access opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your experience.
  • Continuous improvement mindset – where curiosity is encouraged, root-cause problem solving is valued, and making things better every day is part of how we win.


At APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations, we enable global trade and drive sustainable growth. As part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, we connect economies and communities worldwide. Our success is driven by a strong commitment to LEAN methodologies, embedding continuous improvement into every aspect of our operations. Join us and be part of a team that values excellence, collaboration, and innovation. Join us as we continue to shape the future of global trade and make a meaningful impact on communities worldwide. Discover your potential with APM Terminals and become part of a team that's redefining industry standards. Apply now and let's build a brighter future together.


The Opportunity


APM Terminals is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join the team in Pecém, Brazil. This role plays a critical part in attracting, engaging, and hiring top talent while delivering an exceptional candidate experience. Acting as a strategic partner to hiring managers and stakeholders, the Talent Acquisition Specialist will help build diverse, high-performing teams that support business growth and operational excellence.


This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about connecting great talent with meaningful career opportunities, enjoys building strong relationships, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What you'll be doing


Talent Sourcing

  • Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans.
  • Advertise open positions and proactively source qualified candidates.
  • Identify and assess internal talent for career opportunities.


Candidate Assessment

  • Review resumes and conduct initial candidate screenings.
  • Coordinate and facilitate phone interviews and selection processes.
  • Manage assessment activities and support hiring decisions.
  • Initiate and review background screening processes.


Offer Management

  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure alignment on compensation, benefits, and offer governance.
  • Support successful offer negotiations and candidate acceptance.


Market Intelligence

  • Analyze talent markets and identify the most effective sourcing channels.
  • Stay informed on recruitment trends, talent insights, and industry best practices.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with hiring managers throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Gather and manage interview feedback to support informed hiring decisions.
  • Partner with onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition for new hires.


Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and hiring statuses in Workday.
  • Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and local labor regulations.


What we can offer


At APM Terminals, we foster a dynamic learning and training culture that empowers employees to excel. Our commitment to continuous improvement is driven by LEAN principles, ensuring every team member has opportunities to develop new capabilities and advance their careers. Join an innovative environment where growth is a priority and where employees benefit from:

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Exposure to a global business and international career paths.
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture.
  • Opportunities to contribute to transformation and innovation initiatives.
  • A workplace that values safety, well-being, and professional growth.


What we are looking for


The ideal candidate is passionate about matching talent to business needs and delivering an exceptional candidate experience from application to onboarding. They are comfortable managing multiple priorities, working independently, and building strong relationships with candidates and stakeholders.


Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English.
  • Spanish is considered an advantage.
  • Experience with process improvement, standardization, and project implementation is a plus.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to assess talent and make data-driven hiring decisions.
  • Excellent collaboration, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of employer branding and candidate attraction strategies.
  • Experience supporting Diversity & Inclusion initiatives within Talent Acquisition.
  • Structured work approach with a focus on delivering results.


Lean-minded: we are looking for someone who brings a strong mindset of continuous improvement – someone who is naturally curious, committed to solving problems at the root, and driven to make things better every day.


About APM Terminals


A.P. Moller-Maersk is an integrated container logistics company that connects and simplifies supply chains across the globe. Operating in more than 130 countries and employing approximately 70,000 people worldwide, we help our customers trade and grow by delivering end-to-end logistics solutions and digital services.

title: Gerente Comercial
description:
Gerente Comercial (Head of Sales)


Local de Trabalho

  • Base: Grande São Paulo.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido (40% home office).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (aproximadamente 60% do tempo).


Objetivo da Posição

O (a) Gerente Comercial será responsável por definir e executar a estratégia comercial da empresa, impulsionando o crescimento sustentável dos negócios e a expansão da participação de mercado. Atuará de forma integrada com as áreas de Marketing, Supply Chain, Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento e demais áreas estratégicas, assegurando a excelência na execução comercial e o fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, distribuidores e contas-chave.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar o planejamento estratégico da área comercial, alinhado aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Definir e executar estratégias para ampliação da participação de mercado nos segmentos de atuação.
  • Elaborar, revisar e acompanhar o forecast de vendas, garantindo elevado alinhamento com Supply Chain e planejamento da demanda.
  • Definir metas comerciais por região, estado, segmento, aplicação, produto e canal de vendas.
  • Liderar a implementação das estratégias comerciais junto à equipe de vendas, assegurando a execução dos planos de ação.
  • Analisar tendências de mercado e orientar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e soluções em conjunto com as áreas técnicas e de Marketing.
  • Definir e implementar políticas de preços e condições comerciais alinhadas à proposta de valor da empresa.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer parcerias estratégicas com distribuidores, estabelecendo planos de crescimento e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o relacionamento com hospitais, clínicas, redes de saúde e demais instituições, com foco especial em Key Accounts.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe comercial por meio de coaching, gestão de desempenho e desenvolvimento de competências.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua do processo comercial, aumentando a efetividade do ciclo de vendas por meio da utilização de ferramentas de CRM, indicadores de desempenho e melhores práticas comerciais.


Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

  • Crescimento do EBITDA.
  • Crescimento da Margem Direta (valor absoluto e percentual).
  • Otimização do Cash Net Working Capital (cNWC).


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Biologia, Biomedicina, Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial.
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área comercial, preferencialmente no setor de saúde, com foco em produtos consumíveis.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão e desenvolvimento de equipes comerciais.
  • Aplicação e comportamento do produto no mercado
  • Conhecimento em Administração Hospitalar.
  • Domínio das práticas de Key Account Management.
  • Experiência com sistemas de CRM e gestão de indicadores comerciais.
  • Conhecimento avançado do Pacote Office.
  • Inglês fluente.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (aproximadamente 60%).


Competências

  • Liderança inspiradora e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Forte orientação para resultados.
  • Visão estratégica de mercado.
  • Excelente capacidade de negociação e influência.
  • Pensamento analítico e orientação para tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal em diferentes níveis organizacionais.
  • Planejamento e organização.
  • Adaptabilidade e foco em inovação.
  • Perfil colaborativo e forte capacidade de execução.


Diferenciais

  • Espanhol fluente ou avançado.
  • Experiência em empresas multinacionais.
  • Vivência em organizações com estrutura matricial.


Head of Sales


Location

  • Based in the Greater São Paulo area, Brazil.
  • Hybrid work model (40% remote).
  • Availability to travel frequently (approximately 60% of the time).


Position Summary

The Head of Sales is responsible for defining and executing the company's commercial strategy, driving sustainable business growth and expanding market share. This role works closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Research & Development, and other strategic functions to ensure commercial excellence while strengthening relationships with customers, distributors, and key accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the commercial strategic plan aligned with the company's business objectives.
  • Define and implement strategies to increase market share across target segments.
  • Develop, review, and monitor sales forecasts, ensuring close alignment with Supply Chain and demand planning.
  • Establish sales targets by region, state, market segment, application, product, and sales channel.
  • Lead the execution of commercial strategies through the sales team, ensuring effective implementation of action plans.
  • Analyze market trends and collaborate with Technical and Marketing teams to support the development of new products and solutions.
  • Define and implement pricing policies and commercial terms aligned with the company's value proposition.
  • Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships with distributors by establishing growth and performance plans.

title: 3d Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

Nossa tecnologia própria é o one-stop-shop da prevenção à fraude: uma plataforma customizável que atua como mais uma camada de segurança na sua operação, entregando onboarding e transações com a maior performance do mercado.

Já são mais de 23 milhões de brasileiros verificados, +R$ 100 milhões em fraudes antecipadas e Liveness Inteligente que se adapta ao risco real de cada transação.

Basic Functions and Responsibilities includes, but are not limited to:


▪ To coordinate the preparation, review, approval, and maintenance of all Intrials

Quality Management System (QMS) documentation, including SOPs, Policies, and

other controlled documents, as required.

▪ To review and support the implementation of quality processes to ensure that clinical

trials conducted by Intrials are performed in compliance with applicable regulations,

ICH-GCP guidelines, study protocols, and Intrials' or Sponsor's (SOPs).

▪ To prepare the Vendor Qualification process according to Intrials’s SOP and client

expectations (internal and external).

▪ To plan, coordinate, and participate in internal and external audits, sponsor audits,

and regulatory inspections, providing quality support before, during, and after the

audit or inspection process if applicable.

▪ To coordinate the onboarding quality process for new employees, ensuring

completion of mandatory Quality Management System and GxP training

requirements.

▪ To manage the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring its maintenance,

continuous improvement, and compliance with applicable regulations and company

procedures.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System, ensuring

its proper administration, maintenance, user support, and compliance with validated

state requirements.

▪ To support the validation and lifecycle management of computerized GxP systems,

ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal

procedures.

▪ To manage the deviation process, including deviation review, investigation

oversight, root cause analysis, CAPA definition, and effectiveness follow-up.

▪ To provide Quality Assurance guidance to internal departments regarding GxP

compliance, quality processes, and regulatory requirements.


Primary Activities includes, but are not limited to:


▪ To lead the vendor qualification and requalification program, including qualification

assessments, vendor audits, audit reporting, and ongoing performance monitoring

in accordance with Intrials' Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable

regulatory requirements.

including site audits, Trial Master File (TMF) audits, process audits, and vendor

audits, ensuring compliance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, sponsor

requirements, and Intrials' SOPs.

logistics, documentation, and responses.

cause investigations, reviewing and approving CAPA plans, monitoring

sponsors, vendors, and other business partners to ensure alignment with regulatory

and contractual quality requirements.

(QMS), ensuring that quality processes remain effective, compliant, and aligned with

applicable regulations, ICH-GCP E6(R3), and industry best practices.

▪ To develop, review, maintain, and implement controlled quality documents,

including SOPs, Policies, Work Instructions, templates, and other QMS

documentation.

▪ To develop and deliver GCP and Quality Management training programs, ensuring

personnel maintain the competencies required for their assigned responsibilities.

analyzing quality metrics and trends, recommending process improvements, and

supporting the implementation of risk-based quality management initiatives.

▪ To maintain current knowledge of applicable regulations, ICH-GCP guidelines, and

GCP requirements by participating in professional development activities, training

programs, and scientific meetings, applying acquired knowledge to strengthen the

organization's Quality Management System.

assignment and completion of mandatory training within established timelines.

investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA implementation and effectiveness

verification.

compliance with company procedures and regulatory expectations.

System metrics and quality indicators.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS),

including user administration, workflow configuration, change requests, issue

management and liaison with the software vendor.

documentation review, risk assessments, change control evaluation, periodic review

activities and maintenance of the validated state.

▪ To support periodic reviews of validated computerized systems to ensure continued

compliance with GxP requirements.

▪ To participate in Change Control activities related to quality processes and

computerized systems.

▪ To ensure Quality records are properly maintained, archived and readily available for

audits and inspections.

▪ To support the preparation, review and implementation of Quality Metrics and

Management Review reports.

▪ To identify opportunities for continuous improvement and lead Quality initiatives to
